requirement.description: The accs entries validation in _parse_config_file method is too strict and doesn't properly handle certain valid accs entry formats, causing test_1 to fail with "accs entries must be 'rwmdgGha: user1, user2, ...'" error.
requirement.contract: Fix the accs entry parsing logic in _parse_config_file method to properly accept valid accs formats that don't conform to the strict regex pattern, particularly when dealing with whitespace and special characters in user identifiers.

requirement.description: The section header validation logic incorrectly rejects valid section headers in configuration files, causing tests 2, 4, and 5 to fail with "invalid section header" error.
requirement.contract: Improve the section header detection and validation logic to correctly identify valid section headers like "[/volume]" and allow valid configuration file formats.

requirement.description: The configuration parsing logic fails to properly handle the case where a volume path is defined but not immediately followed by a filesystem path, causing test_3 to fail with AssertionError.
requirement.contract: Fix the condition checking for volume path definitions in _parse_config_file method to correctly handle cases where filesystem paths are properly defined after volume declarations.

requirement.description: The user identifier parsing in _read_vol_str method doesn't properly handle comma-separated user lists that might contain periods or other special characters, causing issues with user permissions.
requirement.contract: Enhance the user identifier parsing logic in _read_vol_str method to properly split and validate comma-separated user lists while preserving special characters in identifiers.

requirement.description: The undot function in util.py does not correctly handle edge cases in path resolution, particularly when dealing with paths ending with "..", causing the VFS test to fail with incorrect path resolution.
requirement.contract: Update the undot function in util.py to correctly handle all edge cases including paths that end with ".." and ensure proper path normalization.
